title: SearchConfig
description: The reviewed configuration of decision-time search (ADR-026 section 5): reviewed data in config/search/, never code. Every value that changes what a search plays is here or in an input the search identity names. Integers only. Its RFC 8785 SHA-256 is search_config_hash, a part of the search identity. The values committed first are ADR-026's defaults; they are frozen only by the S0 freeze commit. A change of any value is a new record (a new file), never an edit.

format_id.description: The target format the search is configured for.

kind.description: One-ply re-rank of the prior's top candidates.

top_k.description: How many of the pair's non-pending candidates are searched (k).

top_k_rule.description: prior-top-k takes the k highest, ties in canonical order; distinct-slot takes the next candidate only if it adds a slot action not yet covered.

redraws.description: Sampler indices tried per world until it passes the world checks (R); attempt r of world i is sampler index i * R + r.

hp_rounding.description: How a shown opponent percentage becomes hit points in a world. It changes which worlds pass check V3 and so what is played, hence it is part of the identity. ceil inverts the Champions display for every maximum of 100 or more.

prior.description: The prior arm the worlds are drawn from and the label every result of the arm carries.

belief_identity_hash.description: ADR-025's belief_identity_hash of the belief the worlds are drawn from: 64 lower-case hex digits. The search identity names the same value and the reader refuses a different one.

max_damage_ppm.description: Weight of the probe max-damage reply in millionths; the uniform draws share the rest equally.

uniform_draws.description: Uniform replies over the non-pending legal replies per world.

budget_ms.description: The per-decision guard in milliseconds that an overrun is a latency forfeit against (the existing 30 s battle budget); not a cut-off inside the search, whose work is fixed by k, N, M and R.

a2_clock_floor_ms.description: A2 only: below this remaining bank the search is skipped and the pair's own choice is played.

min_valid_worlds.description: W_min: a decision is searched only if at least this many worlds are valid.

seed_derivation.description: The per-decision search stream: SHA-256 over the JCS of {seed, game, player, policy_id, request_seq, purpose: 'search/1'}.
